author: PlayStation
description:
Watch C4SH, the Rogue, rip through enemies using the (literal) aces up his sleeves.
As the first of two new Vault Hunters coming to Borderlands 4 via paid Story Packs, C4SH is playable across the entire game. You can experience everything on Kairos using his unique set of skills, or dive right into the new Story Pack 1 content via a new menu option, which fast-forwards any fresh Vault Hunter to the new Whispering Glacier map zone at level 13!
C4SH brings an all new playstyle to Kairos, and can use spell-slinging cards from his mystical Deck of Kanansi, dual-wielded revolvers, or eldritch totems summoned by the rolls of enchanted Bone Dice.

author: PlayStation
description:
Take the fight to the Dragon Lords now: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10010360

In this action-ARPG, play solo, in local co-op (2-player) or any combination of up to 4 players online, build your city, and your legacy as you tear through the Dragonkin, unlock new abilities, and find near gear. 

Or if you prefer, play solo and offline, with no need to be permanently online, but still adding your new characters to the city.

Train your wyrmling, find a gameplay style that suits you by powering up skills on the Ancestral Grid, and clear out the Dragon Hordes. 

Dragonkin: The Banished is out now for owners of the Blood Scale edition, and will unlock for everyone on March 19th.
